import json,datetime
d=json.load(open('products/services/open-software-tender/raw/feed-page1.json'))

now=datetime.datetime(2026,11,7,tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
for r in rels:
  t=r.get('tender',{})

  dl=(t.get('tenderPeriod') or {}).get('endDate')
  print(r.get('id'),r.get('tag'),t.get('status'),dl,'|',(t.get('title') or '')[:90],'|',sorted(set(x for x in cpvs if x))[:6],'|',(r.get('buyer') or {}).get('name'))
